headline: Epack Durable submits September quarter SEBI compliance certificate
hook: Routine regulatory filing for Epack Durable
summary: Epack Durable has submitted its standard SEBI compliance certificate for the quarter ending September. The filing is a procedural regulatory requirement for listed companies in India. No financial results or strategic updates were disclosed in this filing. For retail investors, this is standard administrative paperwork rather than a stock-moving event.
why_it_matters: Purely procedural paperwork; no impact on share price.
